title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: recommended thresholds in the policy wizard
summary: Hold: the briefing promises that existing policy thresholds remain unchanged even though Microsoft has not stated the release default. It also understates who can access analytics insights and omits required choices from the policy-wizard route. The roadmap facts and most descriptions of the related preview are supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no automation call to enable or disable insider risk analytics.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Insider Risk Management analytics enable disable PowerShell Security Compliance Graph API'; also searched Exchange PowerShell and Graph API references for Insider Risk Management analytics settings. Read analytics and results; no setting operation found.

claims.claim: The complete route is Insider Risk Management > Policies > Create policy > template > Indicators > Apply thresholds specific to your users' activity.
claims.quote: On the **Policy template** page, choose a policy category and then select the template for the new policy.
claims.fix: Narrow controls[1].ui.path to 'Insider Risk Management > Policies' and set its docs to https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/insider-risk-management-configure, which documents that route. Retain its existing preview and prerequisite note, appending "The policy workflow offers Apply thresholds specific to your users' activity." The current purported full wizard route omits the policy-category choice and template-dependent intermediate choices; a route ending on Policies avoids inventing one universal wizard sequence.
